title: Legal Services
agency_path: City of New York > Campaign Finance Board
submit_to: 100 Church Street, 12th Floor, New York, NY 10007
description_text:
Pursuant to PPB Rule 3-04(b)(2)(iv) of the Procurement Policy Board Rules, The Campaign Finance Board (CFB) intends to enter a Negotiated Acquisition with Lankler Siffert & Wohl LLP to provide services covering legal services to support with advice on anticipated litigation, which includes advice to CFB on legal risk arising from campaign audits and enforcement processes and leading the efforts for an independent performance audit/review of these processes that is required to support the CFBs Legal Services Support for Performance Audit of the CFB Campaign Audit Function and Process project. 

Contractor Address: 1185 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY 10036

Maximum Value: $250,000

Contract Term: 12/1/2026 through 11/30/2027

Renewal Clauses: One (1) renewal option for one (1) year, from 12/1/2027 through 11/30/2028.

There is a need to procure Legal services or consulting services in support of anticipated litigation, investigative, or confidential services. For further opportunities, please visit nyccfb.info/vendors.
